newsitem.title: USA: Bank of New York Q1 net interest income falls.
newsitem.headline: Bank of New York Q1 net interest income falls.

text.p: The Bank of New York said on Monday that its net interest income declined to $496 million in the first quarter of 1997 from $521 million for the same period a year ago.
The bank said that decline reflects the sale of about $900 million in credit card receivables to Associates National Bank, effective January 1, 1997.
It also reflects the sale of the Union credit card receivables in the second quarter of 1996, the bank said.

Average fully diluted shares outstanding were 405 million, down from 428 million a year ago. That decline reflects the company's stock buyback program, largely offset by the conversion of warrants and the issuance of stock to benefit plans, the bank said.
